COVID-NET conducts population-based surveillance for laboratory-confirmed COVID-19–associated hospitalizations in 99 counties across 14 U.S. states.
This analysis describes weekly hospitalization rates among infants and children aged 0–4 years during March 1, 2020–February 19, 2022

methods_quotes.q: Unadjusted weekly COVID-19–associated hospitalization rates were calculated by dividing the total number of hospitalized patients by the population estimates within each age group
Rate ratios (RR) comparing Omicron- and Delta-predominant periods and 95% CIs were calculated.
Wilcoxon rank-sum tests and chi-square tests were used to compare medians and proportions, respectively; p-values <0.05 were considered statistically significant.
Percentages were weighted to account for the probability of selection for sampled cases and adjusted to account for nonresponse.
For the period of Omicron predominance, proportions were compared by age (<6 months, 6–23 months, and 2–4 years).
Three-week moving averages are presented for visualization purposes.
